summary: Under Ruling D6 (the iotsupport-app log shows the operator deleted device fhwiwoxa and model somfy_remote at 07:25 UTC), IoTSupport is migrated to the toolchain's arch-validate, has somfy_remote dropped from firmware-products.yaml, and is pushed alone (c38bd6f). IoTSupport/IoTSupport #146 green, iot-prd Synced/Healthy at IotDeploy dd7a27c, AaC/IoTSupport #42 green (first since #37, arch-validate in the aac-tools container), Architecture #2314 and the site pin rolled.
